The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the beacon funding graph is rebuilt from the mesa history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 152 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
